Reference platform

Appearance

Pick up at the seam

The three recorded fixture updates sit after the last reading bookmark. Tap the seam or “View work” to inspect them.

Scripted design fixtures. No server, camera, agent, or credentials are accessed. Send, reconnect, and stop affect this exhibit only.

The phone can close.
The work stays.

Execution belongs to your server. Reopening restores the same session, then catches up with its actual history.

A compatible continuation-aware server is required. VPS process termination is a separate interruption; a mobile connection cannot make a killed daemon keep running.

Every screen
has a reason.

A few focused places, with enough depth to inspect the work.

Motion with
a point.

A sheet comes from the bottom edge. Your reading position stays stable. Nothing dances to pretend the agent is progressing.

Hierarchy

Conversation first. Tools unfold on demand. No ornamental metrics.

Continuity

A return seam marks unseen recorded work. The server remains the authority.

Feel

Immediate touch response. Short, interruptible motion. Quiet at rest.

Performance

Bounded histories, lazy detail, no per-token animation, and no background polling.

Access

Large targets, real labels, scalable type, and a considered Reduced Motion path.
